Rules

Always pair input with a <label> — placeholder alone is not accessible.
Use hint text for guidance, error text for validation failures. Never both at once.
Required fields show * next to the label, not after the input.
Disabled inputs are read-only display — never use disabled to communicate "not yet allowed."
